Eating it will provide a temporary boost to your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Trouts are a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make Frozen Trouts by freezing [[Chillfin Trout]]s, [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s, [[Voltfin Trout]], or [[Stealthfin Trout]]s with a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} The flavor of the Trouts has been condensed due to being frozen. Eating one restores one of Link's [[Heart]]s and grants one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Trouts are again a variety of [[Frozen Food]], which can be made by exposing [[Chillfin Trout]]s, [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s, [[Voltfin Trout]], or [[Stealthfin Trout]]s to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Freezing Trouts results in their flavor being condensed. If [[Link]] eats a Frozen Trout, he will restore one of his [[Heart]]s and receive one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Food * Roasted Trout * Trout }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
